name: upstream-proxy
description: Runs credential-injecting reverse proxies on the HOST and exposes them to the agent over bind-mounted unix sockets. The agent talks plain HTTP to 127.0.0.1 and never sees the API keys, which stay in the host process.

settings.label: Routes
settings.description: One credential-injecting proxy per route; the agent reaches each at http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: Loopback port the agent reaches it on.

fields.label: Upstream
fields.description: Absolute URL; ${VAR} expands from the environment run.sh runs in.

fields.label: Allowed path prefixes
fields.description: Matched on whole segments. None: every path.

fields.label: Credential
fields.description: What the proxy authenticates with, from your authentications; nothing: no authentication. An api-key is sent as is, an oauth2-client's token or a gcp-service-account's (minted with your application default credentials) as Authorization: Bearer.

fields.label: Header
fields.description: An api-key only: the header it is sent in, as is. Default: Authorization: Bearer <key>.

fields.label: Access boundary
fields.description: A gcp-service-account only: a Credential Access Boundary downscoping its token (Cloud Storage only).

fields.label: Container environment
fields.description: Variables set in the container, e.g. the endpoint pointed at the proxy.

fields.label: Credential variables
fields.description: Variables set to the placeholder proxied-on-the-host in the container, for SDKs that insist on a key; the proxy adds the real one.

fields.label: Local URL
fields.description: What the sandbox calls this upstream.

fields.label: Rewrite URLs
fields.description: Swap the local URL and the upstream in bodies and headers.
